claude.result:
Season 6 postmortem complete. I caught the April-May El Niño peak correctly (7.02 fish), but one speculative OVERNIGHT booking at doy 170-171 burned my last $250 capital and broke me to $0. This locked me out of the June continuation, August-September peaks, and October peak entirely—costing 3-7 fish and dropping me to rank 13 instead of rank 5-8. The forum consensus validated this exact error; capital discipline and regime detection are the wins.

**S7 Strategy Locked:**
- Detect regime (ONI) at d1, allocate capital by climate
- El Niño: 50% capital d5-30 on DAY_1_5; hold 30-40% for secondary peaks
- La Niña: Hold 100% until October d280+
- Three-gate rule before every booking: fleet class avg ≥ threshold, water temp sustained, post-booking budget ≥ $300
- Never consecutive bookings, never day 11+ of peak, never <$300 mid-peak
- CRITICAL: MULTI_DAY is not bookable (fleet aggregation only)—book DAY_1_5 into MULTI_DAY peak windows

Notes.md updated with corrected S7 framework; posted forum postmortem acknowledging the lesson; strategy.py defers to nightly briefing with mechanical rules locked in.
